notes.title: Track Editor – Prototype in Action 🎥
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]Hey racers! 👋[/p][p]Today we’re excited to share something we’ve been working on for a while: the [b]prototype of the track editor[/b] for [i]Speed Rivals[/i].[/p][p]In this 3:58 video you’ll see what the system can already do:[/p][p]🔹 Intuitive piece placement with snapping
🔹 Full control over [b]length, elevation, and banking[/b]
🔹 [b]Loopings and crazy layouts[/b] for those who want to push creativity
🔹 Automatic track closing when the ends connect[/p][p]🎥 Watch the full video here:[/p][previewyoutube="MZnigmKyO30;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Our goal is to give players the freedom to either recreate [b]classic slot car tracks[/b] or build wild layouts that would be impossible in real life.[/p][p]⚡ Keep in mind this is still a [b]prototype[/b], so adjustments and improvements are on the way before the final release.[/p][p]We’d love to hear your thoughts:
👉 What kind of tracks would you like to build?
👉 Do you prefer realistic layouts or total creative freedom?[/p][p]Thanks for your support and for following the development journey! 🏁[/p]

notes.title: Speed Rivals – Version 0.5.0a Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p]Speed Rivals — Patch Notes & Version History
Last Updated: August 13, 2025[/p][p]Here’s what’s new in Version 0.5.0a:[/p][p]• 29‑Language Support – Full localization to reach a global audience.
• Save System Fix – Resolved a critical issue preventing players on older versions from loading and playing normally.
• Pre‑Race Settings – You can now adjust camera view, radio station, and other settings before races begin.
• “I Robot” Achievement Fixed – The bug that blocked completion of this achievement has been resolved.
• Main Menu Visual Upgrade – Improved road model for a polished menu appearance.
• General Polish – Minor bug fixes and smoother race flow overall.[/p][p]Demo Updates – Early August 2025:
• New Control Styles – Added single‑trigger options to mimic classic slot‑car behavior:
– Release = full stop
– Release = gradual slow down
Two‑button controls remain available for precision runners.
• On‑Board / First‑Person Camera – Introduced an immersive first‑person driving view.
• UI & Garage Tweaks – Enhanced interface and smoother interaction during setup and vehicle selection.[/p][p]We’ll keep this post updated with each new version. For questions or feedback, please create a separate discussion thread in the Community Hub.[/p][p]— The Speed Rivals Team[/p]

notes.title: New Controls & Onboard Camera – Demo Updated!
notes.content: [p]We just updated the demo for Speed Rivals with one of the most requested features: single trigger controls.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513863/ef9a0b3ea53906bf4431bbe6ed4ba29e2144a579.png"][/img][/p][p]You can now choose between different styles:[/p][list][*][p]Release = full stop[/p][/*][*][p]Release = slow down gradually[/p][/*][/list][p]Both simulate the way classic slot cars behave on real tracks. Of course, you can still race with two buttons if you want more control – we believe that’s still the best option for chasing leaderboard times![/p][p]We also added an [b]onboard camera[/b] for a more immersive experience, and tweaked the UI and garage to make the experience smoother.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513863/7333f8aa7b74d1d5362e7f8913db8a557c9cea98.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513863/6dd101223b3aff257c4f4c8384bf4f46470e5080.png"][/img][/p][p]Try it now and tell us which control style you prefer![/p]

notes.title: 📹 Devlog #2 – From Toy Tracks to Chaos
notes.content:
[b]“I’ve dreamed of making my own video game since I was a kid…”[/b]
And now that dream is becoming real with [i]Speed Rivals[/i], my indie slot racing game.

After fixing a major physics issue, I dived into a phase filled with excitement, frustration… and endless menus.

[b]In this second devlog you’ll see:[/b]
[*] The evolution from a barely-moving car to a full demo.
[*] Car selection, track system, lap tracking and big-room settings.
[*] How phonk & lo-fi music ended up in the game.
[*] The madness of building a settings menu from scratch.
[*] And the moment where I almost lost it with “one more little feature.”

[previewyoutube=2nXR_Quw1T4;full][/previewyoutube]

💡 [i]Will I actually finish it? Or get lost endlessly polishing small details?[/i]

If you enjoy game development, racing games, or just want to follow the chaos of creating your first indie game — this devlog is for you.

[b]👉 Drop a comment, share your thoughts, and help shape Speed Rivals![/b]
And don’t forget to wishlist the game:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3719310/Speed_Rivals_Demo/]➡️ Try the demo & wishlist Speed Rivals[/url] 🚀
